latest_release.name: BrowserOS neo v0.52.0
latest_release.body:
### ✨ What's new

- **See what every agent is doing.** The refreshed cockpit shows live task previews, each task's open tabs, and a quick way to jump to the page you need. Quiet tasks now show as idle.

- **Replay tasks at full size.** Open a recording full screen with its steps alongside it. Press **F** to open the replay and **Esc** to return.

- **Find and reuse your skills.** Saved skills now appear as cards with site icons, clearer names, and token savings.

**Maintenance build 0.52.1.1** corrects installer versioning for the 0.52 update. Downloads below use this build.

[Checksums for 0.52.1.1](https://github.com/browseros-ai/BrowserOS/releases/download/browserclaw/v0.52.0/SHA256SUMS-0.52.1.1.txt)
